parsed.name: BioShake微孔板恒温振荡器
parsed.description: 这是一种用于微孔板样品处理的实验室恒温振荡设备，可对板内液体进行振荡混匀并提供温度控制，常用于孵育、酶反应和样品制备等流程。
parsed.description_en: This is a laboratory thermoshaker for processing microplate samples. It provides shaking for liquid mixing and temperature control, and is commonly used for incubation, enzymatic reactions, and sample preparation workflows.

actions.description: 使振荡机构回到初始位置。
actions.description_en: Return the shaker mechanism to its home position.

actions.description: 锁定样品托架或夹持机构。
actions.description_en: Lock the sample holder or clamping mechanism.

actions.description: 按设定转速和时长进行振荡混匀。
actions.description_en: Shake at the specified speed and for the specified duration.

actions.description: 开启温度控制并设置目标温度。
actions.description_en: Turn on temperature control and set the target temperature.

actions.description: 解锁样品托架或夹持机构。
actions.description_en: Unlock the sample holder or clamping mechanism.
